QuestInfo.name: Sickly Cygnus
QuestInfo.0: You heard that Cygnus is very sick. Talk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart asked you to talk to Kiridu for a cure.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiridu.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Kiridu told you not to worry. He must have something in mind.

0.0: I'm so ashamed that I didn't realize Cygnus was so sick... But I hear Kiridu knows of a cure.

yes.0: Please ask Kiridu about how to cure Cygnus.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiridu.)#k

1.0: I heard that Cygnus is very sick. What happened?

yes.0: Ah, don't worry. Newcomers to Ereve often get ill like this. There's a lot of fuzz in the air, as you might imagine.

npc.0: Please go talk to Kiridu. You must hurry.
